title: Miguel Alejandro Sanchez
text:
About
I am a PhD Student in Health Economics and Policy at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. My research uses applied microeconomics to study how incentives, institutions, and regulation shape economic and social outcomes. My current work focuses on health care providers and pharmaceutical markets.
Prior to graduate school, I worked as an Analyst at AmeriHealth Caritas, supporting data-driven decisions for managed care plans.


Education
      Ithaca College - Ithaca, New York
            BA in Economics & BS in Public and Community Health, 2022
      Johns Hopkins University - Baltimore, Maryland
            PhD in Health Economics & Policy, 2027 (expected)
